intro.texto: Ecuador's popular festivals are far more than celebrations. They are a universe of characters that synthesize centuries of Andean worldview, colonial faith, and mestizo creativity. We document them with the rigor they deserve.

ritual.texto: Popular festivals are the heart of Ecuadorian culture. Throughout the year, the streets fill with characters who dance between the sacred and the festive, carrying centuries of Andean identity in every costume, every mask.

proyecto.texto: Nunna documents the characters of Ecuador's traditional festivals. Learn why this project exists.

producto.intro_1: <marca>Nunna</marca> is a living catalog of the characters who bring Ecuador's popular festivals to life. Each one becomes a handmade, hand-painted magnet that comes with its own illustrated card.
producto.intro_2: The back of the card holds its QR code: scan it and you land right on its page, so every magnet is also a doorway into Ecuador's memory.
producto.paso_escanea_texto: The QR code is on the back of your magnet's card. Point your phone's camera at it: no app needed.
producto.paso_descubre_texto: Its full page opens: its legend, its meaning and its origin, in Spanish and English. Every time you scan it.
producto.paso_colecciona_texto: When you finish the page, save it to your collection with your account: it comes with its certificate, your achievements and the characters you're still missing.
producto.visual_girar: Tap the card to flip it
producto.visual_fin_ficha: At the end of the page
